svg.aria-label: AB165 · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Bassman-Amp AB165' layout drawing (D-FE), title block read directly: 'FENDER MODEL "BASSMAN-AMP AB165" LAYOUT' — not a trace

Heater layer: the one part of this board not established against the amplifier's own drawing. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3, V4) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V
supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
